name: gate: no data-rel-error exclusion
why: runFilter()'s gate treats a failed cell as pending, so a keystroke starts a pass. relInitRuns() must move and the spec must notice.

name: scan + stillWants: no relError exclusion
why: A pass that does run picks the failed cell up and re-requests it. The forced relRunPass() must catch it.

name: scan only: no relError exclusion (overlap)
why: KNOWN OVERLAP: _relQueueStillWants() still skips the failed cell, so the spec cannot see this alone. Recorded, not hidden.

name: stillWants only: no relError exclusion (overlap)
why: KNOWN OVERLAP: the candidate scan still skips the failed cell, so the spec cannot see this alone. Recorded, not hidden.

name: L1: failure not evicted
why: The failed promise stays cached, so re-expanding serves the failure again without a request. Recovery must never arrive.

name: collapse: relError not cleared
why: After collapse + expand the cell still carries data-rel-error, the scan skips it, and it is never retried.

name: retries: a single attempt
why: A 503 is called a failure on the first attempt. The 'retried before being called a failure' assertion must catch it.

name: failure marker: no master mirror
why: Multi-table re-render clones a master without the marker, the gate sees a pending cell, and the failure is re-requested.
